title: Cutscene file set
summary: Cutscenes are stored as 54 binders named s<map>_<number>. The EMEVD cutscene id maps to the name by digits: 11010030 means s11_01_0030.
values: /cutscene/sMM_BB_NNNN.cutscenebnd.dcx; loaded as cutscene:/%s.cutscenebnd; DLC paths game_dlc1:/remo and game_dlc2:/remo
how: Archive dictionary listing plus exe path strings.
check: List the archive paths and match an EMEVD id.

title: Cutscene runtime classes
summary: The exe has a remo system. SprjRemoMan manages a cutscene instance. SprjRemoRes loads the binder, extra resources and the map texture set.
values: SprjRemoIns steps: STEP_Init, Play_Init, Play_Wait, Finish, DummyForWarp_*; SprjRemoRes: LoadRemobnd, LoadExtraResource, LoadMapTpf; CutsceneGPARAM; remobase.gparam; name format %s#cut%04d#a%04d
check: Search the exe strings for SprjRemo.

title: Warp-only cutscenes
summary: Some cutscene files are tiny and only exist to warp the player with a fade. The exe has a DummyForWarp step for them.
how: File size plus exe step names.
check: Play id 2502895 and see only a fade and a warp.
note: Sizes show stubs. That they are used purely for warp is inferred from the exe step name.

title: EMEVD play-cutscene family
summary: A family of instructions in bank 2002 starts a cutscene. Variants add a warp, a rotation, a time-of-day change or a ceremony.
values: 2002[1] Play Cutscene to All (id, playback); [2] and warp all; [3] to player; [4] and warp player (id, method, point entity, area, block, player); [5] rotate; [6] change time period; [7] Fade Out and Warp Player; [9]/[10] ceremony; [11] ongoing; [13] warp with lighting; 3[31] IF Ongoing Cutscene Finished
check: Search EMEVD dumps for 2002[4].
note: Ours implements (2002,4) and (2002,13) as an instant warp. Playback is skipped.

title: Playback method argument
summary: The playback argument was seen with values 0 and 16. The meaning of the bit is not decoded.
check: Compare a 16-case cutscene with a 0-case one in game.
note: Possibly a flag such as skippable or fade type. Not confirmed.

title: Fade out and warp
summary: A cutscene or a plain fade can be followed by a warp to a point entity in a map. The fade is a separate step from the cutscene file.
values: 2002[7] Fade Out and Warp Player (point, area, block); 2003[82] Set Menu Fade; 2003[71] Hide HUD
check: Walk through a warp trigger and watch the fade.

title: Map ceremony instructions
summary: Ceremony instructions change the map version for a scene, such as the burned Hirata Estate.
check: Trigger the Hirata burning and note the map set.

title: CutsceneParam rows
summary: The param table has 28 rows. Fields mostly control music around a cutscene.
check: Compare rows with the music change in scenes.

title: Hirata Estate burning
summary: The first big scene. Event 11005800 plays 10000000 and warps to point 1102631 in the Outskirts, with lighting variants. A butterflies scene 10000010 follows (event 11005810).

title: Cutscene call inventory
summary: 105 calls to cutscene instructions exist across the EMEVD files.

title: Hand-over to a fight
summary: A scene finishes and an event then enables the boss or gives control. EMEVD waits with 3[31] IF Ongoing Cutscene Finished before the next step.
values: 3[31] IF Ongoing Cutscene Finished; Genichiro 1110800 off / 1110801 on in event 11115820
check: Play to the boss gate and watch the sequence.

title: Skipping scenes
summary: No skip rule was found in the EMEVD data. The fade and warp family suggests the skip is handled by the cutscene runtime.
check: Press the skip input during a scene.
note: Needs a recording to tell if skip exists.

title: Pre-rendered movies
summary: Movies are Bink 2 files loaded from movie:/%s%s.bk2. Only two exist in the install: the opening and the staff list.
values: openingmovie.bk2 (314346532 bytes); stafflistmovie.bk2 (598104408 bytes); enum names Movie_Advertise, Title, Opening, StaffRoll, EndingBad, EndingGood, OldTale; class CSMovieIns
check: List the movie folder.
note: Ending and old tale movies are not shipped as files here. They may be cutscene binders instead (open-question).

title: Movie subtitle lines
summary: The subtitle file has 71 ids from 8000000 to 8000070. Which movie or scene each belongs to is not known.
values: MovieSubtitle category; ムービー字幕.fmg
check: Play the opening and compare line count.

title: Cutscene music handling
summary: CutsceneParam holds fade times for the music. A flag can pause the previous cutscene's music.
check: Listen to the music fade at scene start and end.

title: Lighting during scenes
summary: A cutscene can set its own sky and light set by a remo base light file. A warp variant takes a time of day and lighting state.
values: remobase.gparam; CutsceneGPARAM; 2002[13] warp with lighting (time of day, desired state)
check: Compare lighting before and after a scene.

title: DLC cutscene path
summary: The exe names separate remo paths for the two DLC data sets.
check: Check the paths in the exe.
note: No DLC data is installed here to verify.

title: Ongoing cutscene wait
summary: Events wait for the end with a condition, so a following step can show a text or enable a boss.
check: Search event dumps for the condition.

summary: Our script layer treats cutscenes as already done and just warps.
